A different approach

You shouldn't have to manage your trip just to enjoy it.

Travel information ends up everywhere: confirmation emails, PDFs, screenshots, tickets and hundreds of photos.

Meelwa brings those pieces together and turns them into a trip that makes sense — with as little manual work as possible.

The idea
“The best travel app is the one you don't have to manage.”

Minimal by default. Powerful when you need it.

Travel more.
Organize less.

Meelwa is being built for people who want their trips to feel simple — before, during and after they travel.

A few questions

Simple answers.

What is Meelwa?

Meelwa is a minimalist travel app that turns your travel material — such as tickets, reservations and photos — into an organized trip timeline.

Do I have to plan my whole trip first?

No. That's the point. You can start with the information you already have and let Meelwa organize it for you.

What can I add to a trip?

The first version focuses on travel files and photos: PDFs, screenshots, tickets, reservations and images from your device.

Is Meelwa available yet?

Not yet. We're building the first version now. Join the waitlist to hear when it's ready.
